description: Self-hosted, open-source enterprise MCP gateway: SSO, OAuth 2.1, per-tool access control, human approvals and a tamper-evident audit log.
rules: Agents connect to one /mcp endpoint; upstream tools are exposed as <server-slug>__<tool>.
Configuration is environment variables only; see .env.example and apps/server/src/config/env.ts.
Local development uses SQLite; production uses Postgres with pgvector.
